it_select.name: it_select
it_select.using: (is_admin() OR is_accountant() OR is_super_teller() OR (current_profile_branch_id() = branch_id))

account_movements_direction_amount_forei.name: account_movements_direction_amount_foreign_check
account_movements_direction_amount_forei.value: (amount_foreign IS NULL) OR ((direction = 'in'::text) AND (amount_foreign >= (0)::numeric)) OR ((direction = 'out'::text) AND (amount_foreign <= (0)::numeric)))) NOT VALID

fee_access.name: fee_access
fee_access.using: ((teller_id = auth.uid()) OR is_admin() OR is_accountant() OR is_auditor() OR is_branch_manager())

shifts_own_teller.name: shifts_own_teller
shifts_own_teller.using: ((teller_id = auth.uid()) OR is_admin() OR is_accountant() OR (is_branch_manager() AND (branch_id = current_profile_branch_id())))

ibt_insert.name: ibt_insert
ibt_insert.withCheck: (is_admin() OR is_accountant() OR is_super_teller() OR ((current_profile_branch_id() = from_branch_id) AND (current_profile_role() <> 'auditor'::text)))

idx_txreq_one_pending_per_ref.name: idx_txreq_one_pending_per_ref
idx_txreq_one_pending_per_ref.where: ((status = 'pending'::text) AND (request_type = ANY (ARRAY['edit'::text, 'delete'::text])) AND (tx_ref IS NOT NULL))

txreq_select.name: txreq_select
txreq_select.using: ((teller_id = auth.uid()) OR is_admin() OR is_accountant() OR is_auditor() OR is_super_teller())
